name: Security Event Receipts
description: All security-relevant events (permission grants, denials, policy violations, boundary crossings) produce durable, tamper-evident, structured receipts stored in the receipt journal.
purpose: Establish a durable, tamper-evident audit trail of all security-relevant events so that incidents can be investigated, policies validated, and compliance demonstrated.
acceptanceCriteria: Security event receipt schema is defined and versioned
All security-sensitive operations produce structured receipts
Receipts include: timestamp, event type, source identity, outcome, policy reference
Receipts cannot be tampered with or deleted by non-admin processes
Receipt journal is queryable for audit and investigation
